THEOI TEXTS LIBRARY

The Theoi Classical Texts Library
 is a collection of translations of works of ancient Greek
        and Roman literature. The theme of the library is classical mythology and so the selection consists primarily of
        ancient poetry, drama and prose accounts of myth.

The Theoi Greek Mythology Website
 (
www.theoi.com
) was
        compiled several years before the creation of this online library and in many cases quotes from different
        translations. It also draws on a considerably wider selection of classical literature. For more information on
        that site's content please refer to the 
Theoi Greek Mythology
          Site Bibliography
.
